title: Release 2026-07-28
content:
This release marks the **stable release** of the `2026-07-28` revision of the Model Context Protocol.

The specification is available on the [official Model Context Protocol website](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28).

For a detailed overview of changes, see [2026-07-28 changelog](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/changelog).
